reviews.text: Great App When Traveling. My wife and I are planning a trip to Türkiye and needed a translation app. Downloaded a bunch of apps and had a native speaker tell us which one she thought was best. She picked Dialog and said the Turkish to English was spot on. English to Turkish was also good but said it used simple words to convey the translation. Not that that is bad because the jest does get conveyed. Another strong point is that it lets you finish your sentence before translating. Other apps cut you off mid sentence. The only negative is the pricing. Seems a bit high to me. Will end up getting a week and then will cancel the subscription.
